knowledge_base_chunks.chunk_text: Tempus workflows can shorten case preparation by centralizing genomic, clinical, and notes review into one workspace, helping teams reduce manual chart digging before tumor board and consult preparation.

In validation materials, Tempus highlighted improved case triage efficiency and faster access to clinically relevant variants, giving teams concrete evidence to discuss for complex oncology decision support.
Implementation options are designed to fit existing pathology and oncology workflows, with phased rollout patterns that limit disruption while teams adopt new testing and review processes.
Organizations evaluating broader genomic adoption often focus on reducing time spent compiling fragmented information and increasing confidence in next-step decisions for higher-volume service lines.

knowledge_base_chunks.chunk_text: Case Study Tempus Sales Copilot Tempus Sales Representatives manage large territories with hundreds of clinics and hospital systems. To be effective, they need to know which doctors are seeing patients that would beneﬁt most from Tempus’s speciﬁc genomic panels. Currently, reps spend hours digging through Salesforce notes, market volume data, and recent clinical publications to prepare for a single 15-minute meeting with a Chief Medical Ofﬁcer (CMO) or an Oncologist. The Problem There is a "data-to-insight" gap. We have the data (testing volumes, new drug approvals), but the sales reps don't have a way to quickly synthesize this into a "Why Tempus, Why Now?" pitch for a speciﬁc prospect. The Challenge Build a prototype of an Tempus Sales Copilot.
